name: Rubin / LSST
full_name: Vera C. Rubin Observatory — Legacy Survey of Space and Time
summary: Ten-year optical time-domain survey whose principal objectives include dark matter and dark energy, alongside Solar-System, Milky-Way and variable-source science.
detection_principle: Repeated wide-field multiband imaging combines weak lensing, dwarf-galaxy counts, stellar streams and microlensing to test dark-matter structure and models.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: The official LSST page explicitly states that the ten-year survey began in June 2026.
